# opnsense_haproxy_fcgi (Resource)

HAProxy FastCGI applications (**Services ▸ HAProxy ▸ Settings ▸ Advanced ▸ FastCGI Applications**, plugin `os-haproxy`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_haproxy_fcgi" "php" {
  name      = "php-fpm"
  docroot   = "/var/www/html"
  index     = "index.php"
  path_info = "^(/.+\\.php)(/.*)?$"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `docroot` (String) Define the document root on the remote host. It will be used to build the default value of FastCGI parameters SCRIPT_FILENAME and PATH_TRANSLATED. It is a mandatory setting.
- `name` (String) Name to identify this FastCGI application.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description for this FastCGI application. Defaults to ``.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable this FastCGI application. Defaults to `true`.
- `get_values` (Boolean) Enable the retrieval of variables about connection management from the FastCGI application by sending the record FCGI_GET_VALUES on connection establishment. Some FastCGI applications do not support this feature and others close the connection immediately after sending their response. As a result, this option is disabled by default. Defaults to `false`.
- `index` (String) Define the script name that will be appended after an URI that ends with a slash ("/") to set the default value of the FastCGI parameter SCRIPT_NAME. It is an optional setting. Defaults to ``.
- `keep_conn` (Boolean) Instruct the FastCGI application to keep the connection open after sending a response. If disabled, the FastCGI application closes the connection after responding to a request. Defaults to `true`.
- `linked_actions` (Set of String) Choose rules to be included in this FastCGI application. Only FastCGI rules are supported. Defaults to `[]`.
- `log_stderr` (Boolean) Enable logging of STDERR messages reported by the FastCGI application. It is an optional setting. By default STDERR messages are ignored. Defaults to `false`.
- `max_reqs` (Number) Define the maximum number of concurrent requests this application will accept. This option may be overwritten if the variable FCGI_MAX_REQS is retrieved during connection establishment. Furthermore, if the application does not support connection multiplexing, this option will be ignored. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `mpxs_conns` (Boolean) Enable the support for connection multiplexing. This option may be overwritten if the variable FCGI_MPXS_CONNS is retrieved during connection establishment. Defaults to `false`.
- `path_info` (String) Define a regular expression to extract the script-name and the path-info from the URL-decoded path, see HAProxy's documentation for further details and examples. Defaults to ``.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the FastCGI application.
